governmentcontracts.us DEA Specialties page: 404. hireveterans.com: page content empty. govconinabox.com: worked.

WebSearch: 7 queries used (Laredo Division 10, AMP Partitions, Laredo toilet partitions, San Antonio/South Texas Division 10, DEA Specialties, Laredo restroom accessories installers, McAllen/Corpus Christi/RGV). None found a partition installer based in Laredo. Laredo is about 150 miles from San Antonio, Corpus Christi and McAllen, so almost no specialty contractor is within the 120-mile radius.

Excluded: national partition distributors with no local base (Prestige Distribution, One Point Partitions, Rocky Duron & Associates of Dallas), Laredo remodelers and handymen, portable toilet rental, SERVPRO, Lowe's.

red_flags: Sells and supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Site footer and contact section show a Bloomsburg, PA address that conflicts with Laredo (looks like template text)
candidates.reason: A commercial door hardware and partition supplier in Laredo that advertises local installation in general. It does not show partition installation specifically, and because it sells partitions itself, it is a buy-around risk.
